releaseNotes: v8.22.14: Codebase modularity refactoring and memory optimization. Decomposed oversized monoliths into dedicated modules (epub_hash_registry, reader_modal_translation_suite, reader_modal_dashboard, app_modal_extensions, app_modal_download_success, translation_chapter_runner), centralized string and regex utilities, and added automatic LRU cache memory eviction for novel covers and illustrations.
